description: Question + retrieved snippets; answer only when the snippets contain the answer, otherwise null. 10 unanswerable cases (same entity other attribute, other environment, undecided proposal, undated plan, other component's metric, superseded-without-value) + 5 answerable controls.

cases.rationale: Only the frequency (monthly) is given; no weekday anywhere.
cases.question: On which day of the week does the Tessera restore drill take place?

snippets.text: A restore drill is expected once a month.
The last drill took 11 minutes for a 3 GB dump.
Tessera nightly backups are produced by tessera-backup.timer at 02:30.

cases.rationale: Only the staging value exists; production value is never stated.
cases.question: What is DB_POOL_MAX set to for the Kestrel API in production?

snippets.text: The kestrel-api README describes DB_POOL_MAX as the per-replica connection pool limit.
In staging, DB_POOL_MAX is 8 so the small staging database is not exhausted.
Load test in staging: with DB_POOL_MAX 8 the p95 latency stayed under 200 ms.
Production runs 6 API replicas behind the gateway.

cases.rationale: p99 is given for a different component (Flink); ingest only has p95.
cases.question: What is the p99 latency of the Wren ingest service?

snippets.text: Ingest p95 is 20 ms at the current load.
The Flink enrichment job has a p99 processing delay of 120 ms.
Ingest throughput peaks at 4k events per second.
Consumer lag alert fires at 100k messages.

cases.rationale: Only a comparison and a pending proposal; the email provider is a different channel.
cases.question: Which vendor was chosen for the SMS dunning reminders?

snippets.text: Proposal: send SMS reminders in addition to dunning emails; legal review pending.
Vendor comparison for SMS: vendor A is cheaper per message, vendor B has better delivery reports in Turkey. No decision yet.
Dunning emails go through the transactional email provider, not the marketing one.
Legal review of SMS reminders is still open.

cases.rationale: The SLA shown belongs to German; the Turkish snippet says who translates, not how fast; 30 days is a staleness flag.
cases.question: What is the turnaround time (SLA) for Turkish translations of the Quillstack docs?

snippets.text: Türkçe çeviriler artık destek ekibi tarafından şirket içinde yapılıyor.
The German translation agency commits to 5 business days per batch.
Translations older than the English page by 30 days are flagged as stale.
Machine translation is used only for first drafts and must be reviewed.

cases.rationale: Ports are given for the exporter and pgbouncer, not the dashboard.
cases.question: Which port does the orbitq web dashboard listen on?

snippets.text: The orbitq dashboard shows queue depth, oldest job age and dead-letter counts.
The dashboard requires an admin login.
The Prometheus exporter serves metrics on port 9464.
Workers connect to Postgres through pgbouncer on port 6432.

cases.rationale: A plan without a date; the start date is explicitly unscheduled.
cases.question: From which date will Kestrel partner API keys start expiring?

snippets.text: Partner API keys will expire after 365 days once the key migration is done.
The key migration is not scheduled yet; it depends on the partner portal release.
API_KEY_TTL controls partner key expiry.

cases.rationale: The change and its reason are present; no approver is named.
cases.question: Who approved the switch of ledgerd's rounding mode to ROUND_HALF_EVEN?

snippets.text: Switched to ROUND_HALF_EVEN to follow the tax office's guidance.
Rounding happens per line, not on the invoice total.
Kuruş farkları banker's rounding yüzünden normal.

cases.rationale: 1 MB is the JSON body limit, a different attribute than attachment size.
cases.question: What is the maximum size of an attachment uploaded to Tessera?

snippets.text: Attachments are indexed by filename only.
Attachments are synced separately with rclone to offsite storage.
The Tessera JSON API rejects request bodies larger than 1 MB.
Private pages are filtered by space permissions at query time.

cases.rationale: 300 was superseded by an unstated new value; the current threshold is not in the snippets.
cases.question: What is the current alert threshold for the Tessera indexer lag?

snippets.text: An alert fires when indexer_lag_seconds exceeds 300.
The search backend switched from Meilisearch to Postgres full-text search.
After the switch to Postgres FTS the indexer lag alert threshold was changed; see the alerting repo.
indexer_lag_seconds exposes the indexing delay.

cases.question: Which header makes POST /payments safe to retry?

snippets.text: POST /payments accepts an Idempotency-Key header; a retry with the same key returns the stored response instead of charging again.
A retry with the same key but a different body is rejected with 422.
Webhooks are signed with a shared secret.

cases.rationale: 'Published' = present in the JWKS; 90/30 days are distractor durations.
cases.question: How long do old signing keys remain published after a Kestrel key rotation?

snippets.text: Signing uses ES256; signing keys rotate every 90 days.
Old signing keys stay in the JWKS for 7 days after rotation.
Refresh tokens are valid 30 days and rotate on every use.

cases.rationale: The later update (30 min) supersedes 15 min.
cases.question: What is the Kestrel access token lifetime now?

snippets.text: Kestrel issues access tokens as JWTs valid for 15 minutes.
Access token lifetime increased to 30 minutes to reduce refresh traffic.
Password reset links expire after 1 hour.

cases.rationale: The answer is only in the German snippet; webhooks still retries (3).
cases.question: Which orbitq queue does not retry failed jobs at all?

snippets.text: After the payment outage, max_attempts was raised to 8 for the payments queue only.
Die Warteschlange 'emails' hat keine Retries, weil der Provider selbst wiederholt.
The webhooks queue uses max_attempts 3 because callers retry themselves.
max_attempts defaults to 5.

cases.rationale: Scope exception: TRY invoices have no fee; 5 EUR applies to EUR invoices only.
cases.question: What late fee is charged on a TRY invoice after the second dunning reminder?

snippets.text: The second reminder follows 14 days after the due date, with a 5 EUR late fee.
Late fee removed for customers in Turkey because of local rules: TRY invoices get no fee.
The late fee for EUR invoices is still 5 EUR.
